items.reply: I change my classification to FP. The PR introduces one goroutine per successful primary write, but each legacy call receives a ten-second timeout derived from the caller’s context, preserving request cancellation. Cancellation is cooperative, so this does not strictly guarantee goroutine termination; however, the issue establishes neither cancellation-resistant blocking nor a workload causing meaningful resource exhaustion. The missing concurrency limit alone supports a speculative capacity concern, not a demonstrated performance defect.
